title: MICA Archive Schema v0.2.0 — Changes from v0.1.8.1
description: This document is the normative v0.2.0 archive schema specification. It defines ONLY the changes from v0.1.8.1. All $defs and properties not listed here are inherited unchanged from mica-v0.1.8.1-universal.schema.json. This patch-as-spec approach ensures the diff is the contract — no silent divergence from copying.

patch_metadata.description: Additive changes: (1) mica_spec optional field added to archive root; (2) mica_schema_version const updated to '0.2.0'; (3) invocation_protocol.primary_pattern enum extended with 'agent_yaml_bootstrap' for Agent OS integration. Legacy archives missing mica_spec are valid but flagged as legacy.

changes.note: New archives must use '0.2.0'. Existing archives with '0.1.8.1' or 'baseline-draft' are legacy-valid but not v0.2.0-compliant.

v0.2.0.description: Version of the mica.yaml composition contract spec that governs this archive's package. When present, must match mica.yaml mica_spec. Mismatch is a machine-detectable drift condition.

changes.note: Optional. Absence is legacy. When present and != mica.yaml mica_spec, this is a DRIFT condition (severity: warning).

New value 'agent_yaml_bootstrap' supports Context 2 (Agent OS) integration. When agent.yaml owns the root, agent.yaml instructions declare MICA loading, making agent.yaml the bootstrap entry point rather than README.

mica_schema_version.description: Schema version identifier. v0.2.0 archives must use '0.2.0'.
mica_schema_version.migration_note: If your archive has '0.1.8.1', update to '0.2.0' on next version bump. If 'baseline-draft', retain as-is (template marker) or update when instantiating.

mica_spec.description: Version of the mica.yaml spec governing this archive's package. Must match mica.yaml mica_spec when both are present. Absence = legacy-valid. Mismatch = drift warning.

rule_1.name: missing_mica_spec_is_legacy
rule_1.action: readable, no validation error. Flag for migration on next version bump.

rule_2.name: mica_spec_version_mismatch
rule_2.action: Both files are readable, but they are on different version axes. Update archive mica_spec on next version bump.

rule_3.name: mica_spec_aligned
rule_3.action: Full machine-verifiable contract. No action needed.

rule_4.name: baseline_draft_preserved
rule_4.action: This is a MICA template (not an instance). Treat as readable but not validatable against v0.2.0 instance rules.

migration_guidance.description: How to apply the compatibility rules to any archive encountered in the wild. The COMPAT rules above are exhaustive — every archive state maps to exactly one rule. No per-project tracking belongs in this spec. Each artifact evolves independently and lands in a COMPAT rule by its own state.
migration_guidance.decision_procedure: Read archive root. Does mica_spec exist? → No: COMPAT-001. Yes, and mica_schema_version == 'baseline-draft': COMPAT-004. Yes, and matches mica.yaml mica_spec: COMPAT-003. Yes, but differs from mica.yaml mica_spec: COMPAT-002.
migration_guidance.update_procedure: On the artifact's next version bump — not before — add mica_spec and update mica_schema_version at archive root. Never force an update on a live archive mid-cycle.
